dataset_info.name: vachan_setu_timeline_tracker_synthetic
dataset_info.description: Seed dataset for deadline calculation, status-freshness and risk classification, with grievance pathways.
dataset_info.data_origin_summary: 100% synthetic. No real citizen data. No record is a real application.

licensing.synthetic_content: Authored for the HaqSetu/Vachan project; license per project policy.
licensing.official_sources: If you add real data from data.gov.in, check each dataset's licence (many use Government Open Data License - India, GODL-India, which requires attribution). For scheme text from ministry portals, cite the portal and date and check reuse terms. Do not scrape or train on private/personal grievance data.

known_limitations: Scheme criteria are paraphrased summaries, not verified against current notifications.
Milestone durations are illustrative, not statutory, unless flagged statutory_candidate and then still needs human verification.
12 records is a seed set for schema design and smoke tests, not enough to train a model; use for few-shot, evaluation, or as a template for scaling.

schema.records[].scheme_id / scheme_name: Links to scheme_catalog in the eligibility dataset.
schema.records[].scenario_type: Slice label for the test case.
schema.records[].citizen_input_text: What the citizen says about their application.
schema.records[].rule_ref: Rule used for calculation: rule_id, rule_version, deadline_basis (illustrative_synthetic | statutory_candidate), day_count_method, holidays_excluded, verification_state, note.
schema.records[].milestones[]: milestone_id, name, stage, expected_offset_days, expected_date (derived), actual_date (citizen-entered or null), status (pending | completed_on_time | completed_late | overdue_unconfirmed), status_source.
schema.records[].events_log[]: Dated events with source (citizen_entered | official_integration | portal_check).
schema.records[].as_of_date: Evaluation date; all derived values are relative to it.
schema.records[].expected_output: Gold labels: final_due_date, days_remaining, deadline_state (on_track | approaching [<=7 days] | overdue | paused_awaiting_citizen | completed_on_time | completed_late), status_freshness (fresh | stale [>14 days] | no_status_data | not_applicable when completed), risk_level, risk_factors, recommended_next_action, status_disclaimer.
schema.records[].grievance_pathway[]: Ordered escalation levels: authority_type, action, channel, earliest.
schema.records[].metadata: Same fields as the eligibility dataset, plus notes.
